_comment: E5a' on the sample: E5c's Sanskrit pairs with a second encoder, BGE-M3 (TSAI, #625, 19 Nov: 'run E5a' with a second encoder ... then E5d's blind threshold sweep'). Request: jobs/2026-11-19-h3-e5c-bge-m3.md. Report-only: h3.py removes nothing. Same inputs, packs and coverage settings as E5c (jobs/2026-11-18-h3-e5c/h3.json), so the two encoders' pairs can be compared document by document. Sentence threshold 0.7 (on FLORES, BGE-M3 qualifies 82% of sa-en and 95% of sa-hi translated blocks at 0.7); doc_floor 0.55 because BGE-M3 scores unrelated text higher than LaBSE (best wrong match median 0.57 against 0.41); the local smoke run at 0.6 kept no candidate. Provisional until E5d. Paths are relative to the repository root.
